authority: RCA-1.8 directive §4; frozen BEFORE first operational enable
enforcement: code-level where mechanically checkable (tests pin them); the rest are binding operator policy recorded here

initial_use_scope.rule: SYNTHETIC / CALIBRATION-ONLY. Enable only on calibration deployments (benchmark series, offline loops, qualification screening infrastructure).
initial_use_scope.real_case_rule: Real-case deployments keep LLM_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS disabled by default; enabling on a real-case deployment requires explicit operator acceptance of the redaction contract and is recorded as a deployment decision, never a default.
initial_use_scope.model_raw_responses: FORBIDDEN in real-case output — the sink structurally never records responses; validation entries carry type+location only (input values dropped at build time, test-pinned).
initial_use_scope.evidence_content: FORBIDDEN — no tool results, no evidence bodies, no snapshots are ever passed to the sink; call sites pass ids/counters only.

default_state.rule: DISABLED by default (LLM_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS unset/false -> sink resolves to None; every emission site is a no-op byte-identical to pre-RCA-1 behaviour).

log_path_and_permissions.rule: LLM_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS_PATH must be an ABSOLUTE path; parent directories are created; the file is created owner-only (0600) before the first append; a relative path raises DiagnosticsPathError at construction (misconfiguration fails loudly, never mid-run).

concurrency.rule: Appends serialized by a process-wide lock. Supported shape: ONE process per diagnostics file (single service deployment). Cross-process fan-out to the same file is NOT supported — use distinct paths or an external collector.

redaction.rule: Captured: stage, ts, normalized code, classified flag, exception class/module, cause class chain, provider HTTP status, validation error type/location (NO input values), schema hash (contract identity), tool name, retry attempt count, request latency, context ids/counters. Forbidden always: API keys, Authorization headers (never touched), evidence bodies, model reasoning, prompts, full prompt/response dumps.

task_deletion_and_retention.rule: The diagnostics file lives OUTSIDE all task stores: benchmark task deletion (§18 cleanup) and investigation deletion never remove it. Retention is EXPLICIT and operator-managed — entries carry `ts`; the recommended calibration rotation is manual truncation between screening rounds. No automatic expiry is implemented (deliberately: no hidden data loss).

failure_isolation.rule: Sink construction and write failures NEVER affect agent results: construction misconfiguration raises at wiring time (fail loud before any run), while write failures inside a run are swallowed (best-effort telemetry; a diagnostics outage can never change an investigation outcome or a screening disposition).
failure_isolation.test: record_failure swallow behaviour + containment tests run with sink attached
